title: Download my data
summary: Baixar meus dados in Privacidade (LGPD art. 18, ADR 0112): after an owner check, gets the JSON copy of everything the Bipe API stores about the account and hands it to the system share sheet.

phase.description: downloading: GET /v1/me/export runs. ready: the share sheet is open.

start.effect: Owner check (biometrics or the phone's screen lock, else the app lock PIN, else refused) with bipe_privacy_export_biometric, then GET /v1/me/export.

share.effect: Saves the body as it is in a private cache folder that holds only the latest export and opens the system share sheet with the file.

notes: The app never parses or logs the file. Messages are not on the server, so the footer says the chat contents are not in the file.
3 exports per hour per account: 429 shows bipe_error_rate_limited.
Bipe logic: BipeAPIClient.exportMyData and BipeDataExport (iOS); BipeAccountSession.exportData, BipeDataExportFile and BipeDataExportRow (Android).
